name: CodEx
aliases: Joint Temporal De-blurring and Tomographic Reconstruction
definition: A modular framework for joint de-blurring and tomographic reconstruction that inverts motion blur introduced in sparse view fly-scanning by encoding acquisition with a known binary code and using a non-convex Bayesian reconstruction algorithm.
summary: CodEx is a modular framework for joint temporal de-blurring and tomographic reconstruction that uses known binary codes to invert motion blur in sparse-view fly-scanning without aliasing or dense sampling requirements.
